blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.
blocks.zh: 约鲁巴语(Yorúbá)是一种通俗通俗的语言,依靠二亚语来避免词汇模糊. 然而,它常常被写作时没有这些二分法,从而阻碍了下游自然语言处理(NLP)任务. 在本文中,我们引入了Yo-ByT5,一种从ByT5-small上微调的字节级自动断裂修复(ADR)模型. 我们评价Yo-ByT5与5个公开发布的Yorúbá ADR模型和1个开放量大语言模型(LLM)在YAD基准上的一致协议. 我们的结果显示,Yo-ByT5与现有最强模型mT5基的性能相匹配,DER为10.14%,CER为3.48%. 此外,尽管使用了大约一半的参数(mT5-基数),但它显示出较好的文字忠诚。 我们还发布了我们的训练守则和示范产出,并呼吁为Yorúbá diacritic修复制定一个更大的、专门制定的基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1 The problem
blocks.zh: 1.1 国家 问题

blocks.en: The Yorùbá language is a Niger-Congo language and one of the three most spoken languages in Nigeria, with more than 50 million speakers across the country and other parts of Africa ( Inuwa-Dutse, 2025 ) . However, despite its mass adoption globally, Yorùbá is classified as a low-resource language. The low availability of computational linguistic resources necessitates this description, despite the rich cultural heritage of the language. The field of ADR makes this resource scarcity particularly evident, as diacritics affect almost every downstream task, from text-to-speech to machine translation and corpus annotation. A systematic review of 105 studies across ten years highlights diacritic dependency as one of the central unsolved challenges for Yorùbá NLP ( Jimoh et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 约鲁巴语是尼日尔-刚果的一种语言,也是尼日利亚最通用语的三种语言之一,全国和非洲其他地区有超过5 000万讲者(Inuwa-Dutse,2025年)。 然而,尽管它在全球被大量采用,但约鲁巴语被归类为低资源语言. 尽管语言具有丰富的文化遗产,但由于计算语言资源不足,因此有必要进行这种描述。 ADR领域使得这种资源稀缺尤其明显,因为二极论影响着几乎所有的下游任务,从文本到语音到机器翻译和实体注释. 对为期十年的105项研究的系统审查突出表明,对二极性依赖是Yorúbá NLP(Jimoh等,2025年)尚未解决的核心挑战之一。

blocks.en: This challenge stems from ambiguity in the Yorùbá writing system. Yorùbá employs diacritics—tone marks and underdots—to disambiguate text, reducing the need for context and auxiliary information to decipher meaning. For instance, in a Yorùbá corpus of about one million words, 85% of words carry diacritics, and 32% of unmarked word types have two or more valid diacritised counterparts ( Orife, 2018 ) . Table 1 shows an example: the word igba has four valid diacritised readings. However, in casual settings such as social media posts and comments, speakers often write in the plain Latin alphabet and rely on context for disambiguation. For downstream NLP tasks, this plain text representation severely degrades performance, necessitating automatic diacritic restoration models.
blocks.zh: 这一挑战源于Yorúbá写作系统的模糊. Yorúbá使用二极论——一分一分和一分一分——来分解文本,从而减少了对上下文和辅助信息破解含义的需要。 例如,在约100万个字的Yorúbá体中,85%的字带有二甲状腺素,32%的无标记字类型有两种或两种以上有效的二甲状腺素对应物(Orife,2018年)。 表1举出一例: igba一词有四个有效的二分读. 然而,在社交媒体帖子和评论等临时场合,演讲者往往会用平话拉丁字母来写作并依赖上下文来混淆. 对于下游的 NLP 任务,这种纯文本的表示会严重地降低性能,从而需要自动地二相还原模型.

blocks.en: Table 1: One undiacritised Yorùbá form, igba , and four valid readings.
blocks.zh: 表1:一种未经诊断的Yorúbá形式,Igba,以及四种有效的读取。

blocks.en: 1.2 Modelling choices for the task
blocks.zh: 1.2 任务的建模选择

blocks.en: ADR is a specialised task with various methodological approaches, ranging from rule- and syllable-based techniques ( Adegbola and Odilinye, 2012 ; Asahiah et al., 2017 ) to modern neural network architectures ( Náplava et al., 2018 ; Olawole et al., 2024 ; Orife et al., 2020 ) . One standard approach frames ADR as a machine translation task using sequence-to-sequence neural models ( Orife, 2018 ) . This framing is intuitive, as diacritics can be treated as properties restored to base characters. However, byte-level modelling advances this concept further.
blocks.zh: ADR是一项专门任务,采用各种方法方法,从基于规则和音节的技术(Adegbola和Odilinye,2012年;Asahiah等人,2017年)到现代神经网络架构(Náplava等人,2018年;Olawole等人,2024年;Orife等人,2020年)。 一个标准方法框架ADR作为机器翻译任务,使用序列到序列神经模型(Orife,2018. 这种框架是直观的,因为二极论可以被当作属性还原为基字符. 然而,字节级建模进一步推动了这一概念.

blocks.en: A byte-level model processes raw text directly without learning a fixed subword vocabulary. This property makes byte-level models robust to spelling variations and eliminates out-of-vocabulary issues ( Xue et al., 2022 ) . Furthermore, they can process text in any language inherently and simplify technical pipelines by removing complex preprocessing steps that could introduce errors. Additionally, subword-based models like mT5 allocate a large share of their parameters (approximately 66% in mT5-base) to vocabulary embeddings and output matrices. In a byte-level model, these parameters can be reallocated to increase network depth or width ( Xue et al., 2021 ; Xue et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 一个字节级模型在不学习固定子词词汇的情况下直接处理原始文本. 这种地产使得字节级模型能够有力地拼写变体并去除伏地出问题(薛等,2022年). 此外,它们还可以用任何语言处理固有文本并简化技术管道,方法是去除可能引入错误的复杂预处理步骤。 此外,基于子词的模型如mT5分配了它们的大部分参数(在mT5-base中约为66%)用于词汇嵌入和输出矩阵. 在字节级模型中,这些参数可以被重新定位来增加网络深度或宽度(薛等,2021;薛等,2022.

blocks.en: 1.3 This paper
blocks.zh: 1.3 国家 本文

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level model based on ByT5-small, fine-tuned for ADR in Yorùbá text. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five other publicly released Yorùbá diacritisers and one open-weight language model across four core metrics: Character Error Rate (CER), Word Error Rate (WER), Diacritic Error Rate (DER), and Word Diacritic Error Rate (WDER). In addition, we analyse decoding strategies in the inference pipeline and assess text fidelity by isolating diacritic errors from structural text modifications. Finally, we release our code and per-sentence outputs at https://github.com/lazy-monster/yo-byt5 to enable reproducible comparisons and extensions by the research community.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了Yo-ByT5,一个以ByT5-small为基础的字节级模型,在Yorúbá文本中对ADR进行了微调. 我们评价Yo-ByT5与其他5个公开发布的Yorúbá分泌器和一个开放量级语言模型,涉及4个核心指标: 字符出错率(CER),出错率(WER),出错率(DER)和出错率(WDER). 此外,我们分析推断管道中的解码策略,并通过将二分校错误从结构文本修改中分离出来来评估文本的忠实性. 最后,我们在https://github.com/lazy-monster/yo-byt5上发布了我们的代码和判决产出,以便研究界能够进行可复制的比较和扩展。

blocks.en: 1.4 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.4 缴款

blocks.en: In this paper, we make the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们作出以下贡献:

blocks.en: 1. Yo-ByT5, an open-weight byte-level ADR model for Yorùbá, alongside its training procedure. 2. A comparison of seven models for the diacritic restoration task including Yo-ByT5, one open-weight language model, and five other publicly available diacritisers on the YAD benchmark under the same scoring protocol. 3. An error typology analysis that demonstrates that text fidelity, rather than error rate, most sharply separates these models from one another, and that Yo-ByT5 preserves the input text far more reliably than any comparably accurate model. 4. Released code, model outputs, and a small patch for the YAD benchmark discovered during evaluation to enable reproducible benchmark results. 5. A call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark dataset for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 Yo-ByT5,是Yorúbá的开放式字节级ADR模型,与其培训程序并列. 2. 比较二极管修复任务的7个模型,包括Yo-ByT5,1个开放量级语言模型,以及同一评分协议下的YAD基准上其他5个可公开使用的分光管. 3. 一种错误类型分析表明,文本的忠实性,而不是出错率,最明显地将这些模型分开,而且Yo-ByT5比任何比较准确的模型更可靠地保存了输入文本。 4. 发布代码,模型输出以及评价期间发现的YAD基准的小补丁,以促成可复制的基准结果. 5. 呼吁为Yorúbá diacritic修复开发一个更大的、专门设计的基准数据集。

blocks.en: Yo-ByT5, an open-weight byte-level ADR model for Yorùbá, alongside its training procedure.
blocks.zh: Yo-ByT5,是Yorúbá的开放式字节级ADR模型,与其培训程序并列.

blocks.en: A comparison of seven models for the diacritic restoration task including Yo-ByT5, one open-weight language model, and five other publicly available diacritisers on the YAD benchmark under the same scoring protocol.
blocks.zh: 对比了包括Yo-ByT5,一款开放量级语言模型,同分协议下的YAD基准上其他5个可公开使用的分光管等7个模型.

blocks.en: An error typology analysis that demonstrates that text fidelity, rather than error rate, most sharply separates these models from one another, and that Yo-ByT5 preserves the input text far more reliably than any comparably accurate model.
blocks.zh: 一种错误类型分析显示,文本的忠实性,而不是出错率,最尖锐地将这些模型相隔开来,而且Yo-ByT5保存了输入文本的可靠性远高于任何可比准确的模型.

blocks.en: Released code, model outputs, and a small patch for the YAD benchmark discovered during evaluation to enable reproducible benchmark results.
blocks.zh: 发布代码,模型输出,以及评价过程中发现的YAD基准的小补丁,以能再生基准结果.

blocks.en: A call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark dataset for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.
blocks.zh: 呼吁为Yorúbá diacritic修复开发一个更大的、专门设计的基准数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Yorùbá diacritic restoration
blocks.zh: 2.1 恢复Yorúbá二审

blocks.en: Early neural work in diacritic restoration by Orife (2018) framed the task as sequence-to-sequence machine translation using attentive recurrent networks, releasing models and data to the public. While their training relied primarily on biblical text, subsequent work identified generalisation limitations on colloquial text, contractions, and loan words ( Orife et al., 2020 ) . Soft-attention sequence-to-sequence models exhibited reduced performance on informal linguistic variants. To address this, Orife et al. (2020) constructed a larger multi-domain corpus, incorporating the JW300 Yorùbá dataset (11.5M words out of 13.9M total), and introduced a news test set for evaluation on modern, non-literary text.
blocks.zh: Orife(2018年)在二极修复方面的早期神经学工作将这项任务设定为用注意的经常性网络进行序列到序列的机器翻译,向公众发布模型和数据. 虽然他们的培训主要依靠圣经文本,但随后的工作查明了对口语文本、收缩和出借词的概括性限制(Orife等,2020年)。 软视序列到序列模型显示出在非正式语言变体上的性能下降。 为了解决这一问题,Orife等人(2020年)构建了一个更大的多域体,纳入了JW300 Yorúbá数据集(总共13.9M个字中有11.5M个字),并引入了一套新闻测试,用于评价现代非文学文本。

blocks.en: Another key contribution is the YAD benchmark, used for evaluation in this paper. Several multilingual T5 models and a Yorùbá-specific T5 model were fine-tuned on YAD’s training split and evaluated using BLEU and ChrF metrics ( Olawole et al., 2024 ) . More recently, Ayoola and Olukanmi (2026) benchmarked four diacritisation models, including general LLMs and fine-tuned models such as mT5-base, reporting CER and DER metrics under their protocol.
blocks.zh: 另一项主要贡献是本报告中用于评价的青年发展基准。 一些多语言的T5模型和一个Yorúbá特有的T5模型在YAD的训练分拆方面进行了微调,并使用BLEU和ChrF的衡量标准进行了评估(Olawole等人,2024年)。 最近,Ayoola和Olukanmi(2026年)以4个二氧化二氮模型为基准,包括一般LLMs和微调模型,如mT5-碱基、根据协议报告CER和DER度量。

blocks.en: 2.2 Corpora and benchmark data
blocks.zh: 2.2 公司和基准数据

blocks.en: MENYO-20k is a multi-domain parallel corpus for Yorùbá and English, constructed specifically with complete and accurate diacritisation, making it highly suitable for ADR tasks ( Adelani et al., 2021 ) . It serves as a foundational source for the YAD benchmark alongside JW300 and the Yorùbá Bible, as well as the training data for Yo-ByT5. JW300 ( Agić and Vulić, 2019 ) remains a prominent resource, though NLP research for Nigerian languages often relies on repurposing existing resources rather than constructing new, high-quality annotated datasets ( Inuwa-Dutse, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: MENYO-20k是Yorúbá和英语的多域平行体,其构造特别完整而精确地分化,因此非常适合ADR任务(Adelani等,2021年). 它与JW300和Yorúbá圣经以及Yo-ByT5的培训数据一起,成为YAD基准的基础来源。 JW300(Agić和Vulić,2019年)仍然是一出出名的资源,虽然尼日利亚语言的NLP研究往往依赖于对现有资源的再利用,而不是构建出新的,高质量的附加说明的数据集(Inuwa-Dutse,2025年).

blocks.en: 2.3 Model architectures
blocks.zh: 2.3 示范建筑

blocks.en: mT5 is a multilingual variant of T5 pre-trained on a Common Crawl dataset spanning 101 languages. The base variant (582.4M parameters) serves as one of the baseline architectures evaluated in this study ( Xue et al., 2021 ) . ByT5 replaces subword vocabularies with raw UTF-8 bytes, offering increased robustness to noise and character variations ( Xue et al., 2022 ) . Our proposed model, Yo-ByT5, fine-tunes ByT5-small (approximately 300M parameters) for Yorùbá ADR.
blocks.zh: 页:1 T5是T5的一个多语种变体,在覆盖101个语言的"共同爬行"数据集上预训. 基变量(582.4M参数)是本研究所评价的基准架构之一(薛等,2021年). ByT5用生的UTF-8字节来取而代之的子词组,为噪声和人物变化提供了更高的强性(薛等,2022). 我们提出的模型"Yo-ByT5",微调了"ByT5-Small"(约300M参数),用于Yorúbá ADR.

blocks.en: 2.4 Large language models for diacritisation
blocks.zh: 2.4 二极化的大型语言模型

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated broad capability across NLP tasks, raising questions regarding their efficacy in ADR. Nadăş and Dioşan (2025) evaluated LLMs on Romanian diacritic restoration, finding that performance varied significantly across model families, with several performing below an echo baseline and highlighting the continued necessity of specialised fine-tuning. Toyin et al. (2025) evaluated 12 LLMs against specialised diacritisers on Arabic and Yorùbá using the MultiDiac test set. While several LLMs outperformed specialised baselines, smaller models frequently exhibited hallucination and text degradation. In this study, we benchmark specialised Yorùbá diacritisers, including Yo-ByT5, against a 120B parameter open-weight LLM on the YAD benchmark.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在NLP任务中表现出了广泛的能力,从而提出了其在发展成果评估中的效力问题。 Nadăş和Dioşan(2025年)评价了关于罗马尼亚二极修复的LLMs,发现各模范家庭的表现相去甚远,有些表现低于回声基线,并强调需要继续进行专门的微调。 陶依仁等编. (2025年)使用多Diac测试集,对阿拉伯语和约鲁巴语的专用分光管进行了12个LLMs的评价。 虽然一些有限责任公司的业绩超过了专门的基准,但较小的模型往往表现出幻觉和文字退化。 在这项研究中,我们参照YAD基准上120B参数的开放式LLM,将Yorúbá diacridiasers(包括Yo-ByT5)作为基准。

blocks.en: 3 Yo-ByT5
blocks.zh: 3个Yo-ByT5

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture and rationale
blocks.zh: 3.1 结构和理由

blocks.en: The underlying architecture for Yo-ByT5 is google/byt5-small , a pre-trained model with 299,637,760 parameters. A byte-level model was selected because diacritisation is fundamentally a character- and byte-level operation involving combining marks attached to base characters. Yo-ByT5 restores both tone marks and underdots to unmarked Yorùbá text.
blocks.zh: Yo-ByT5的基本架构为google/byt5-small.,是一款有299,637,760参数的预训模型. 选择了字节级模型,因为分化从根本上来说是一种字符和字节级操作,涉及将标记与底字符相接. Yo-ByT5既恢复了音调标记,又恢复了未加标记的Yorúbá文本.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training data
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训数据

blocks.en: The Yo-ByT5 training set combines the Yorùbá training split of MENYO-20k (10,070 sentences) and the Biblica Open Yorùbá Contemporary Bible 2017 (36,243 segments), for a total of 46,313 training sentences. We hold out a further 5,305 sentences for validation and 6,633 for internal testing (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: Yo-ByT5训练集结合了Yorúbá训练分出MENYO-20k(10,070句)和Biblica Open Yorúbá当代圣经2017(36,243段),共计46,313个训练分出. 我们又提出5 305个判决用于验证,6 633个判决用于内部测试(图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Yo-ByT5 corpus and fine-tuning lineage. The MENYO-20k train split and the Biblica Open Yorùbá Contemporary Bible 2017 form the training set; the model is initialised from google/byt5-small and fine-tuned on it. The YAD test benchmark, on which Yo-ByT5 is evaluated, is drawn from the MENYO-20k test split.
blocks.zh: 图1:Yo-ByT5体能与细化分泌. MENYO-20k列车拆分出行,"Biblica Open Yorúbá Contenent Bible 2017"组成了训练集;该型号从google/byt5-小号上登出并对其进行了微调. YAD测试基准(Yo-ByT5被评价)取自MENYO-20k测试分出.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training procedure
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训程序

blocks.en: We fine-tuned google/byt5-small on a Google Cloud TPU v6e-8 in two phases. Both phases used AdamW with linear decay, weight decay 0.01, and gradient clipping at a norm of 0.5. The per-device batch size was 4 with gradient accumulation 2 across 8 TPU cores, for an effective global batch size of 64. Both phases tokenised source and target text to at most 1024 bytes and ran for 4 epochs on the training set. The first phase used a learning rate of 2e-4 with 300 warmup steps. The second phase started from the first-phase checkpoint, used a learning rate of 1e-4 with no warmup, and produced the released Yo-ByT5 checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 在Google Cloud TPU v6e-8上,我们分两个阶段微调了google/byt5-small. 两个相相都使用了亚当W,其线性衰变,重量衰减0.01,并按0.5的规范剪接梯度. 每台设备的批量尺寸为4个,梯度累积为2个,跨越8个TPU核心,有效全球批量尺寸为64个。 两个阶段都以最多 1024 字节表示来源和目标文本,并运行在培训集上的4个时代。 第一阶段采用2e-4的学习率,有300个取暖步骤. 第二阶段从第一阶段检查站开始,采用1e-4的学习率,没有热身,并产生了已放行的Yo-ByT5检查站.

blocks.en: 3.4 Contamination check
blocks.zh: 3.4 污染检查

blocks.en: We audit the internal training data against the dev and test splits of the YAD benchmark. The only overlaps are two short strings that also occur in YAD’s official train split: the greeting Ẹ ṣeun (“thank you”), in 4 of the 3,330 test sentences and 11 dev sentences, and a boilerplate header line, in 8 dev sentences. Therefore, we can evaluate Yo-ByT5 on the YAD benchmark without meaningful leakage.
blocks.zh: 我们对照YAD基准的平分和测试,审计内部培训数据。 唯一重叠之处是YAD官方列车拆分中也出现的两条短线:在3,330个测试句和11个dev句中的4个,以及8个dev句中的锅炉板头线。 因此,我们可以对Yo-ByT5进行YAD基准评估,而不发生有意义的渗漏.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准

blocks.en: The benchmark we evaluate the models on is the test split of the YAD dataset, which contains 3,330 sentences drawn from MENYO-20k ( Olawole et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价模型的基准是YAD数据集的测试分解,其中包含从MENYO-20k(Olawole等,2024年)中提取的3,330句.

blocks.en: 4.2 Models compared
blocks.zh: 4.2 模型比较

blocks.en: We compare seven models in total: Yo-ByT5; five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models (mT5-base, two omowe-T5 variants, ByT5-small menyo, and mT5-small); and one open-weight LLM baseline (gpt-oss:120b evaluated via Ollama Cloud with one-shot prompting at temperature 0). Table 2 lists each model with its public repository, architecture, and parameter count.
blocks.zh: 我们总共比较了7个模型: Yo-ByT5;5个公开发布Yorúbá ADR模型(mT5-base,两个Momowe-T5变体,ByT5-smallmenyo,和mT5-small);以及1个开口量的LLM基线(gpt-oss:120b通过Ollama Cloud评估,一发一发在0温度下提示). 表2列出每个模型及其公共寄存器,架构和参数计数.

blocks.en: Table 2: Evaluated models: Yo-ByT5, five publicly released Yorùbá diacritisers, and one open-weight LLM baseline.
blocks.zh: 表2:评估模型: Yo-ByT5,有5个公开发布Yorúbá diacritisers,以及1个开放式LLM基线.

blocks.en: 4.3 Decoding
blocks.zh: 4.3 解码

blocks.en: We use deterministic decoding throughout the evaluation pipeline for reproducibility. Furthermore, since the observed performance of weaker models changes by up to 10.5 CER points when decoding strategy is varied, we use both greedy and beam decoding for comprehensiveness. However, we find that the two strongest models change by at most 0.12 points regardless of the decoding strategy.
blocks.zh: 在整个评估过程中,我们使用决定性的解码来进行再生产。 此外,由于所观察到的较弱模型的性能在解码策略不同时会变化至可达10.5个CER分,因此我们既使用贪婪又使用光束解码来进行综合. 然而,我们发现,无论解码策略如何,两种最强的模型最多变化了0.12分.

blocks.en: 4.4 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 计量

blocks.en: We report eight evaluation metrics: Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), Diacritic Error Rate (DER), Word Diacritic Error Rate (WDER), Underdot DER (DER-underdot), Tone DER (DER-tone), BLEU, and ChrF.
blocks.zh: 我们报告八个评价指标: 单词出错率(WER),字符出错率(CER),分数出错率(DER),分数出错率(WDER),分数出错率(DER-underdot),分数出错(DER-通),分数出错率(BLEU)和ChrF.

blocks.en: WER and CER measure edit distance (substitutions, deletions, insertions) between model outputs and reference text at the word and character levels using Levenshtein distance ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Ayoola and Olukanmi, 2026 ) . DER measures the percentage of diacritised reference letters assigned incorrect diacritics ( Zitouni et al., 2006 ; Fadel et al., 2019 ; Ayoola and Olukanmi, 2026 ) . We also break down DER into DER-underdot and DER-tone. WDER measures the proportion of diacritised reference words that the model does not reproduce exactly. BLEU and ChrF are computed using sacrebleu ( Post, 2018 ) with pinned tokenisation settings.
blocks.zh: WER和CER用Levenshtein相距测量模型输出和字符级参考文本之间的编辑距离(替代,删除,插入) (Levenshtein, 1966; Ayoola and Olukanmi, 2026). DER测量指定不正确的二极体的二极体参考字母的百分比(Zitouni等人,2006年;Fadel等人,2019年;Ayoola和Olukanmi,2026年)。 我们还将DER拆分为DER-underdot和DER-通. WDER测量了模型不准确复制的二分法参考词的比例. BLEU和ChrF是使用有被标注符号设置的sacrebleu(Post,2018)来计算.

blocks.en: To prevent structural edits (insertions, deletions, substitutions) from inflating error metrics via misalignment, reference and output words are aligned on their unmarked base forms using Needleman-Wunsch alignment prior to evaluating diacritic accuracy ( Needleman and Wunsch, 1970 ; Aldallal et al., 2025 ) . Furthermore, references and outputs are normalised to a consistent Unicode form ( Unicode Consortium, 2025 ) . We also identified that 3.56% of underdot diacritics in the YAD benchmark used non-standard Unicode codepoints. These were corrected prior to evaluation, and the correction patch is released alongside our code.
blocks.zh: 为了防止结构编辑(插入、删除、替换)通过错误对齐来夸大误差的度量,参考词和输出词在评价二评准确性之前,使用Needleman-Wunsch对齐(Needleman和Wunsch, 1970;Aldallal等, 2025)按其无标记的基础形式对齐。 此外,参考文献和产出均按统一的Unicode格式(Unicode Consortium,2025.)正常化。 我们还确认,在YAD基准中,3.56%的低点二极管使用了非标准的Unicode编码点. 在评估前已经纠正了 修正补丁和我们的代码一起发布

blocks.en: 4.5 Error typology and text fidelity
blocks.zh: 4.5 错误类型和文本忠诚

blocks.en: While aggregate metrics like DER and CER quantify overall performance, they fail to characterise specific error types, such as whether a model struggles more with tone marks or underdots. To address this, we categorise every erroneous word into one of six main classes based on our base-word alignment:
blocks.zh: 虽然DER和CER等汇总度量衡对总体性能进行量化,但它们未能对具体的出错类型进行定性,例如模型是用音标还是用下调来挣扎. 为了解决这个问题,我们把每一个错误的单词归为六个主要类别中的一个,根据我们的基词组合:

blocks.en: • Diacritic errors (base form correct): – Tone-only: one or more incorrect tone marks. – Underdot-only: one or more incorrect underdots. – Mixed: errors in both tone and underdots. • Text-altering errors: – Lexical substitution: the output word has a different base form than the reference. – Deletion: the reference word is absent from the output. – Insertion: the output includes a word not in the reference.
blocks.zh: • 诊断错误(基准表格正确):- 只发音: 一个或多个不正确的音调标记 。 - 仅少写:一个或多个不正确的小写. – 混合:音调和下调均出错. ^ 文本更改错误: – Lexical 取而代之:输出词的基数形式不同于引用. – 说吧 – 删除: 输出时没有引用单词 。 - 插入:输出包括参考文献中没有的单词.

blocks.en: Diacritic errors (base form correct): – Tone-only: one or more incorrect tone marks. – Underdot-only: one or more incorrect underdots. – Mixed: errors in both tone and underdots.
blocks.zh: Diacritic 错误( 基准表正确): - 只发音: 一个或多个不正确的音调标记 。 - 仅少写:一个或多个不正确的小写. – 混合:音调和下调均出错.

blocks.en: Tone-only: one or more incorrect tone marks.
blocks.zh: 只通音:一个或多个不正确的音调标记.

blocks.en: Underdot-only: one or more incorrect underdots.
blocks.zh: 仅少写:一个或多个不正确的小写.

blocks.en: Mixed: errors in both tone and underdots.
blocks.zh: 混合:音调和下调都出错.

blocks.en: Text-altering errors: – Lexical substitution: the output word has a different base form than the reference. – Deletion: the reference word is absent from the output. – Insertion: the output includes a word not in the reference.
blocks.zh: 文本更改错误: – Lexical 取而代之:输出词的基数形式与参考词不同. – 说吧 – 删除: 输出时没有引用单词 。 - 插入:输出包括参考文献中没有的单词.

blocks.en: Lexical substitution: the output word has a different base form than the reference.
blocks.zh: 语法取而代之:输出词的基词形式与参考词不同.

blocks.en: Deletion: the reference word is absent from the output.
blocks.zh: 删除:产出中缺少参考词.

blocks.en: Insertion: the output includes a word not in the reference.
blocks.zh: 插入:输出包括参考文献中没有的单词.

blocks.en: We quantify text fidelity by calculating the ratio of lexical substitutions, deletions, and insertions to total errors, termed the text-altering rate. A lower ratio indicates higher fidelity, as errors are limited to diacritics. We report this metric for all seven models using a greedy decoding pipeline to ensure that the results reflect each model’s natural tendencies.
blocks.zh: 我们通过计算词汇替代、删除和插入与总误差的比率来量化文本的忠实性,这称为文本转换率。 较低的比率表明忠诚度较高,因为错误仅限于二甲论者。 我们用一个贪婪的解码管道对所有七个模型报告这个指标,以确保结果反映每个模型的自然趋势。

blocks.en: 4.6 Environment
blocks.zh: 4.6 环境

blocks.en: The evaluation runs on a single NVIDIA T4 GPU. The software versions are pinned and are: Python 3.12.13, torch 2.10.0+cu128, transformers 4.57.6, sacrebleu 2.6.0.
blocks.zh: 评估运行在单NVIDIA T4 GPU上. 软件版本被固定为:Python 3.12.13,火炬 2.1.0+cu128,变压器 4.57.6,sacrebleu 2.6.0.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 5.1 Overall comparison
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 总体比较

blocks.en: Table 3 reports every metric for all seven models on the YAD test benchmark, under one decoding and scoring protocol (except for gpt-oss:120b), sorted by DER. We refer to the numbers in the table throughout the rest of this section.
blocks.zh: 表3按一个解码和打分协议(gpt-oss:120b除外),按DER排序,将所有7个模型的分量都报告在YAD测试基准上. 我们指的是本节其余部分表中的数字。

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison on the YAD test benchmark (3,330 sentences), corrected YAD test set, base-word Needleman-Wunsch alignment. Beam decoding ( num_beams = 5). Sorted by DER; best value per column in bold. * gpt-oss:120b is run one-shot at temperature 0, not beam search.
blocks.zh: 表3:YAD测试基准比较(3,330句),校正YAD测试集,基词Needleman-Wunsch对接. 束解码(num_束=5). 按DER排序;以粗体表示的每栏最佳值。 *gpt-oss:120b在0温下运行一发,不是光束搜索.

blocks.en: 5.2 Yo-ByT5 and mT5-base: parity at a fraction of the size
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 Yo-ByT5和mT5-基数:大小相差一分之平分

blocks.en: Yo-ByT5 and mT5-base emerge as the leading ADR models for Yorùbá. On DER the two models are close enough that the gap is within the margin of error, as we confirmed with a resampling test where we redrew the test set 10,000 times. On the other metrics each model has an edge: Yo-ByT5 is better on CER, while mT5-base is better on word diacritic error rate and slightly better on WER. Yo-ByT5 reaches this level with 299.6M parameters against mT5-base’s 582.4M, roughly half the size.
blocks.zh: Yo-ByT5和mT5-base成为Yorúbá的主要ADR模型. 在DER上,两个型号距离足够近,差距在出错的幅度内,正如我们通过重新取样测试所证实的,我们重置了1万次测试。 在其他衡量尺度上,每个模型都有一个边缘: Yo-ByT5在CER上比较好,而mT5-base则在词二甲校正误差率上比较好,在WER上稍好. Yo-ByT5与mT5-base的582.4M的299.6M参数达到这个水平,大约是大小的一半.

blocks.en: 5.3 Error analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 错误分析

blocks.en: In addition to error rates, preserving input text fidelity is a critical requirement for ADR models. As shown in Figure 2 , Yo-ByT5 demonstrates superior fidelity, altering base input text in only 0.84% of its errors. In contrast, mT5-base alters base text in 26.42% of errors, gpt-oss:120b in 22.91%, and other public baselines in 57.9% to 82.7% of errors.
blocks.zh: 除出错率外,保存输入文本的忠实性是ADR模型的关键要求. 如图2所示,Yo-ByT5表现出了优越的忠诚,仅以0.84%的差错更改了基础输入文本. 相形之下,mT5-碱基在26.42%的误差中会改变基文本,gpt-oss:120b在22.91%的误差中会改变基文本,其他公共基线在57.9%到82.7%的误差中会改变基文本.

blocks.en: An important finding is that byte-level architecture alone does not guarantee fidelity. The other publicly released byte-level model with the same underlying architecture as Yo-ByT5, ByT5-small menyo, alters text in 59.79% of its errors, compared to 0.84% for Yo-ByT5. This shows that training data and procedure remain paramount, and decide whether the inherent copying advantage of the byte-level architecture is realised.
blocks.zh: 一个重要的发现是,单是字节级建筑并不能保证忠诚。 另一个公开发布的字节级模型与Yo-ByT5,ByT5-small menyo具有相同的基础架构,在其59.79%的出错中修改了文本,而Yo-ByT5的修改率为0.84%. 这表明培训数据和程序仍然至关重要,并决定字节架构的固有复制优势是否实现。

blocks.en: We also find that tone-only errors outnumber underdot-only errors consistently across every model, indicating that the models struggle more with tone marks than with underdots. Furthermore, we discover that DER alone is not sufficient to evaluate a model, as one model, omowe-T5 menyo, scores a DER that puts it in the middle of the group, but its CER and WER are among the worst. This motivates reporting DER alongside WER and CER for a holistic view of a model’s capabilities rather than DER alone.
blocks.zh: 我们还发现,在所有模型中,只注意音调的错误总是超过只注意音调的错误,这表明模型在语调标记上比在底调上挣扎得更快。 此外,我们发现单靠DER并不足以评估一个模型,因为一个模型Momowe-T5 menyo的得分将它放在组的中间,但其CER和WER是最差的. 这促使人们与WER和CER一起报告DER,以便从整体上看待模型的能力,而不只是DER。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Word error typology across the seven evaluated models (corrected YAD test, greedy decoding). Blue hues: the three mark classes. Orange hues: the three text-altering classes. The text-altering share is stated beside each bar.
blocks.zh: 图 2:7个评价模型的文字错误类型(修正了YAD测试,贪婪地解码). 蓝花花:为三等分. 橙花花:三个文字变化类. 每个栏旁都注明更改文本的份额。

blocks.en: 5.4 Open-weight language model baseline
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 开放式语言模型基线

blocks.en: The 120B-parameter general large language model scores a DER of 28.42% versus 10.14% for Yo-ByT5. It ranks third among the seven models on CER and fifth on DER, indicating that it produces coherent output but unreliable diacritics. This corroborates that for the Yorùbá language, specialised fine-tuning still beats general-purpose language models on diacritic restoration ( Nadăş and Dioşan, 2025 ) . Interestingly, text fidelity falls sharply with input length, from 53.4% of sentences under 60 characters to 3.0% of those with 240 or more. Figure 3 plots this decline across the five length bands.
blocks.zh: 120B参数的通用大语言模型对Yo-ByT5的DER评分为28.42%,对10.14%. 它在CER的7个模型中排名第3位,在DER中排名第5位,表明它能产生一致的输出但不可靠的二甲酸. 这证明,对Yorúbá语而言,专门的微调仍然比通用语言模型在二极修复方面要好(Nadăş和Dioşan,2025年)。 有趣的是,文本的忠实性随着输入长度而急剧下降,从60个字符以下的53.4%到240个字符以上的3.0%。 图3显示了五个长度带的下降情况。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Base-text preservation by gpt-oss:120b against input sentence length (YAD test). The share of outputs that keep the base text falls from 53.4% on the shortest sentences to 3.0% on the longest.
blocks.zh: 图3:按gpt-oss:120b对输入句长(YAD测试)来保存底文本. 保留基准文本的产出比例从最短句的53.4%下降到最长句的3.0%。

blocks.en: 5.5 Decoding strategy
blocks.zh: 5.5 解码战略

blocks.en: The performance of the two most accurate models, Yo-ByT5 and mT5-base, remains steady across different decoding strategies, with greedy and beam decoding staying within 0.12 CER points for both models. However, for the weakest public models, beam search recovers up to 10.5 CER points. This suggests that a comparison that fixes one decoding strategy runs the risk of misranking the weaker models.
blocks.zh: 两个最准确的模型Yo-ByT5和mT5-base的性能在不同的解码策略间保持平稳,贪婪和梁解码在两个模型的0.12CER分以内. 然而,对于最弱的公共模式,光束搜索恢复了高达10.5个CER分. 这表明,通过比较来修正一种解码策略,就有可能对较弱的模型进行错误排序。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level ADR model for Yorùbá, and evaluate it alongside five public diacritisers and an open-weight LLM under a unified benchmark protocol. Yo-ByT5 matches the accuracy of the top subword baseline while utilising half the parameters and exhibiting superior input text fidelity. Our analysis confirms that text fidelity is a key differentiator across models that is not captured by DER alone. All code, outputs, and dataset patches are released to support future research.
blocks.zh: 我们为Yorúbá推出Yo-ByT5, 一个字节级的ADR模型, Yo-ByT5 匹配了顶端子词基线的精度,同时使用了一半的参数,并表现出了优异的输入文本的忠实性. 我们的分析证实,文本的忠实性是不同模型的关键不同因素,而单是DER无法捕捉到。 发布所有代码,输出,和数据集补丁以支持未来的研究.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The alignment algorithm used in the evaluation matches words one-to-one. Therefore, if a model splits or merges a word, the algorithm marks it as a substitution plus a gap rather than a simple change, which could slightly affect scores.
blocks.zh: 评价中使用的对齐算法与单词相匹配. 因此,如果一个模型将一个单词分出或合并,算法将它标记为一个替代加一个缺口而不是一个简单的变化,这可能略微地影响分数.

blocks.en: Our LLM baseline was one model of one size with one prompt, and we report a single run. Future studies should perform further ablation studies, evaluating different models, using varying prompts, and running inference multiple times since LLMs sometimes give different outputs for the same input.
blocks.zh: 我们的LLM基线是一个单一尺寸的模型,一个快速,我们报告一次运行。 未来的研究应进一步进行减退研究,评价不同的模型,使用不同的提示,并进行多次推论,因为LLMS有时会为同样的输入提供不同的输出.

blocks.en: About 78% of the training data is biblical text (36,243 of 46,313 sentences). Prior work has shown that over-reliance on biblical corpora can limit generalisation to colloquial text, contractions, and loan words ( Orife et al., 2020 ) . Our evaluation uses the multi-domain YAD benchmark, so the reported scores are not measured on scripture, but a training corpus balanced across more domains may improve performance on informal text.
blocks.zh: 约78%的培训数据是圣经文本(46,313句中的36,243句). 先前的研究表明,过度依赖圣经中的corpora可以将通俗化限制在口语文字,收缩和出借词上(Orife等,2020.). 我们的评价采用多领域YAD基准,因此所报告的分数不是用经文衡量的,但是,在更多领域实现平衡的培训大纲可以改善非正式文本的绩效。

blocks.en: These limitations show why we need a larger, dedicated dataset for Yorùbá diacritic restoration. Future benchmarks should focus on diacritic restoration alone and cover a wider variety of contexts than the 3,330 sentences used in the YAD benchmark.
blocks.zh: 这些限制说明为什么我们需要一个更大的,专用的数据集,用于Yorúbá diacritic修复. 今后的基准应仅注重二极修复,并涵盖比YAD基准中使用的3,330句更广泛的背景。
